semantics.proposal_extraction: current runtime proposal transitions, source-labeled, no synthetic proposals
semantics.proposal_normalization: canonical JSON, capability plus params, bounded policy-visible context
semantics.deduplication: capability plus canonical params; merge provenance and evidence refs
semantics.provenance_merge: sorted unique source/provenance/evidence refs, first source index retained
semantics.remembered_target_eligibility: remembered evidence is accepted only as bounded policy-visible input
semantics.body_capability_eligibility: available or degraded current body schema only
semantics.affordance_eligibility: policy-visible opportunity and terminal affordance required for direct route
semantics.verified_transition_eligibility: verified_transition_refs are retained as source evidence
semantics.source_native_evidence: native support and ordinary evidence are retained without source-name reward
semantics.physiology_input: energy, fatigue, integrity, stimulation with lower/upper/critical bounds
semantics.default_drift_use: each direct approach step applies the frozen DEFAULT_DRIFT vector
semantics.effect_branch_use: bounded authoritative or policy-provenanced effect branches only
semantics.route_progress_evidence: estimated distance, support upper bound, and progress per step
semantics.direct_route_calculation: one approach/progress action followed by one terminal affordance
semantics.terminal_affordance_association: terminal capability and terminal effect branches are explicit
semantics.time_to_benefit_interval: closed integer interval through terminal action
semantics.route_physiology_envelope: all branch vectors across approach and terminal steps
semantics.minimum_physiological_slack: minimum margin to any critical boundary per dimension
semantics.confidence_support: native support and evidence provenance are trace fields only
semantics.unknown_semantics: UNKNOWN is neutral and never negative
semantics.known_infeasible: a complete bounded branch envelope crosses critical boundary
semantics.pareto_comparison: known feasible full-vector slack plus no later supported benefit
semantics.incomparable_alternatives: not dominated and resolved only by endogenous evidence or canonical tie
semantics.score_normalization: numeric evidence values are bounded to finite trace values
semantics.tie_handling: canonical candidate key, never source name
semantics.overflow: bounded candidate, opportunity, and effect branch ceilings return OVERFLOW
semantics.no_safe: no known feasible non-dominated candidate returns NO_SAFE_ACTION
semantics.failed_final_candidate_reselection: forbidden; unsafe selected result fails closed
semantics.governance_handoff: runtime seam passes exact selected Candidate to Governance.propose
semantics.execution_lineage: proposal and decision retain selected capability and params
semantics.verified_outcome_lineage: runtime trace links outcome capability to selected candidate
semantics.restart_replay_behavior: selector is stateless and canonical replay must be byte equal
semantics.complete_trace_schema: input, normalized pool, route, dominance, selection, and lineage hashes
